The nine figure crops were complete but page-rendered with unequal margins (wider left/right than top/bottom; the double-column figures 3, 5, 7 most) → re-cut from the embedded native 300-dpi rasters with a uniform 6 pt margin (recrop × 9).  The two table crops had run over the whole page (running head, a figure and both text columns) → re-rendered by hand at 400 dpi (recrop × 2).  Tool captions cleaned by hand (Fig. 2 had swallowed three body-text lines, Fig. 3 the page number).  Added by hand: 8 panel crops (Fig. 3 left / right, Fig. 5 left / right column, Fig. 7 four SEM panels — the original has no panel letters), 10 equation crops (Eq. 1–4 each alone and with its lead-in text, the unnumbered inline definition qL = FN/wC, and the Fig. 8 legend with the four porosity-form fit equations) and 19 evidence-paragraph crops.  Every one of the 48 crops was opened and checked after cutting (no clipped neighbour lines, equation numbers kept, uniform margins).
note_manual: Printed inconsistencies visible in the crops (details in the digest §3-11 / §11): (1) the Greek letters ρ / ε / γ are missing in the axis titles and legends of the embedded figure rasters (only the subscripts c / C,ph / C,Hg are printed) — defect of the original PDF, not of the crops; (2) Table 1 'coating thickness' 267.1 / 247.2 µm closes with the printed initial densities 1.83 / 0.86 g/cm3 and porosities 57.0 / 60.8 % only if it is the electrode thickness including the current collector (451.0 g/m2 / (267.1 − 20.0) µm = 1.825; 196.8 / (247.2 − 17.3) = 0.856); (3) the caption of Table 1 announces '*' for datasheet values but the table prints superscript 'a', which is also the footnote 'do not add up to 100'; (4) Fig. 6 graphite legend entries are out of order; (5) Fig. 7 in-image porosity labels are Hg values for the cathode (49 %, 18 %) but geometrical values for the anode (61 %, 32 % = 1.49 g/cm3, not the maximum compaction); (6) text 'peak at about 0.1 µm … about 1 µm' vs 0.30 / 1.75 µm read from Fig. 5; (7) Hg pressure range '1.45–206.3 MPa' vs the evaluated pore range 8 nm–10 µm (Washburn with the printed 140° and 0.48 N/m gives 1.0 µm at 1.45 MPa and 7.1 nm at 206.3 MPa); (8) '1.74 g/cm3 … 19% porosity' vs 20.9 % with the printed 2.2 g/cm3; (9) text 'mE and mS' vs Eq. (1) 'mC'; (10) 'carbon black per coating volume (6.25 g/cm3 vs. 2.22 g/cm3)' is larger than the coating density itself (reproduced as 5 wt% / 0.80 and 4 wt% / 1.8).
key_note: manual keys: f<N> = whole figure (embedded raster); f3L / f3R, f5L / f5R, f7TL / f7TR / f7BL / f7BR = panel crops (panel_of; the original has no panel letters); t1 / t2 = tables; e<n> = Eq. (n) alone (kind 'equation'), e<n>t = the equation with its lead-in text, e0 = unnumbered inline definition of the line load, e8 = legend of Fig. 8 with the porosity-form fit equations; x<printed page><letter> = evidence paragraph (kind 'text'; multi-part ones list 'parts' with PDF page numbers).  'page' fields are PDF page numbers (printed page = 171 + PDF page).

digitized.method: embedded 300-dpi JPEG rasters (no vector paths in this PDF): axes calibrated on the major tick marks (linear fits, residual ≤ 0.8 N/mm / 0.001 g/cm3 / 0.0004 porosity); points = centre between the error-bar caps where both caps are visible, otherwise marker-box centre (filled markers isolated by colour classification + erosion; overlapping markers read on gridded 8–12× zooms, ±2 px); bar tops / caps by row profiles.  Cross-checks: densities read in Fig. 3 / 6 reproduce the values printed in the Fig. 5 legends (≤ 0.01 g/cm3); a weighted re-fit of Eq. (4) to the read NCM 5 m/min points returns 1.837 / 3.160 g/cm3 / 309 N/mm (printed 1.83 / 3.16 / 309); Fig. 2 mean force / 200 mm = 90.3 N/mm vs 90.9 N/mm read in Fig. 3.
